verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Disputes API that lets merchants retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents, which covers the evidence-submission half of the story. The pack has no dispute-specific evidence for notifying merchants of new chargebacks, and nothing on deadline tracking or reminders. Missing for 10: documented chargeback/dispute notification (e.g., dispute webhook events), deadline visibility or reminders for defense windows, Customer Area dispute workflow for merchant-ops users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline

citations.quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
